_notes: PEP decisions ledger. Entries accumulate as reconcile surfaces novel items and the user resolves each to a model row. Per the 2026-04-25 variant collapse, model_sheet is informational; the actual sheet routed to at write time comes from SHEET_NAME[(filing_type, statement_type)] in reconcile. Ticker-ledger aliases must match what `normalize_label` produces (lowercase, articles 'the'/'our' stripped, trailing parens stripped). The us_gaap_concepts field is informational only on ticker entries today — concept-fallback runs against the generic library only — so the alias list must cover every label variant PEP renders.

new_rows.note: FY2024 divestiture of Tropicana / Naked / Izze juice business to PAI Partners (closed Q4 FY2024). Non-cash add-back removing the IS gain from CFO. PEP-specific (one-time event), so kept on ticker ledger rather than promoted to generic library.
Cash received from the FY2024 sale of the juice business. Investing-section inflow. Paired with PEP-CF-001 (the non-cash add-back) and PEP-IS-001 (IS gain line).

IS line for the Juice Transaction. PEP renders this line INSIDE the Operating Profit calculation — visually placed between SG&A and Impairment, value rendered in parens-negative (-3,321 in FY2022, the held-for-sale loss recognized when Juice was classified as held-for-sale). Filing_section MUST be operating_expenses (not non_operating) so model-write's cascade-subtotal injection algorithm doesn't see a fake section transition that would push IFO/PT subtotals into the middle of the bucket. Sign convention left unset — value comes through as-mapped from parens-negative detection. The actual close gain in FY2024 wasn't broken out as a separate line (PEP netted it through Impairment of intangibles).
Non-cash CFO add-back for the FY2024 Quaker Foods recall reserve. Paired with PEP-CF-004 (cash payments).

Non-cash CFO add-back for the bucketed impairment + restructuring + uncollectible receivable charges PEP groups under one line in the CF reconciliation. RUCCBPIC variant is the FY2024 quarterly disclosure tag for the same concept. Aliases cover both the standard 'charges' label and the slash-separated 'charges/(credits)' or '(credits)/charges' variants where the parenthetical-credits branch falls in the middle of the label and isn't stripped by TRAILING_PAREN_RE.
